support.a1: Choose an active offer, read its conditions and allergens, select the quantity and confirm. Sign in as a customer to receive a pickup code.

legal.academic: FoodSave by Smiling Food — academic frontend demonstration.
legal.terms1Body: This frontend demonstrates how FoodSave connects customers and food businesses in Lima. Sample businesses, offers and accounts are fictional. A reservation made here is not a real purchase or a commitment by a real restaurant.
legal.terms2Body: Choose customer or business owner when registering. Use fictional contact information and a password you do not use elsewhere. Account access is simulated locally; it is not a production authentication service.
legal.terms3Body: Read prices, allergens, ingredients, availability and pickup conditions before reserving. Businesses must keep food information accurate. Ask the business about allergies and cross-contact; a missing declaration does not mean the food is allergen-free.
legal.terms4Body: Reserve only an active offer with enough units. Cancellation is available before pickup starts. Show the one-use pickup code during the stated window. Reservations expire when that window ends. This demonstration does not process online payments, delivery or refunds. Business sales carry a plan-based commission: Free 5%, Plus 7%, Pro 10%. Subscriptions have monthly prices and simulated payments. FoodSave covers customer subscription discounts.
legal.terms5Body: A customer may submit one rating after a confirmed pickup. Use respectful, relevant comments. The help page lets you record a local request; it does not send messages to a support team in this demonstration.
legal.privacy1Body: The demonstration stores names, email addresses, phone numbers, business information, offers, reservations, reviews, preferences and support requests that you enter. Use fictional information.
legal.privacy2Body: Records and the selected language are stored in localStorage on this device. The current account identifier is stored in sessionStorage. Passwords are stored as salted PBKDF2 hashes, but local browser access is not production security. Do not use sensitive data.
legal.privacy3Body: Your browser requests permission only when you select Use my location. Coordinates are used in memory to calculate approximate distances and are not saved by this demonstration.
legal.privacy4Body: Business maps load OpenStreetMap. Fonts load from Google Fonts. These providers receive ordinary connection information under their own policies. Uploaded photos are stored in this browser. No analytics tracker is configured.
legal.privacy5Body: Clear this site’s browser data to remove your local records and session. No remote backend is connected and there is no remote account deletion request in this demonstration.

CUSTOMER.FREE: Discover offers and reserve meals without a monthly fee.
CUSTOMER.PLUS: An extra discount for your regular purchases.
CUSTOMER.PRO: A bigger discount and a higher monthly savings limit.

BUSINESS_OWNER.FREE: Start selling surplus food and manage your pickups.
BUSINESS_OWNER.PLUS: Publish more offers and keep track of your results.
BUSINESS_OWNER.PRO: Expand your catalog and highlight offers to reach more customers.
